verdict.rationale: Fathom provides a documented public REST API with API-key auth, quickstart, endpoints (recordings, transcripts, summaries, webhooks, users), OAuth for public apps, and official TypeScript/Python SDKs that handle auth/pagination/errors, all backed by extensive first-party docs. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on third-party corroboration and no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found 404s), which slightly limits programmatic tooling.
